name: AI Assistant
description: AI assistant with RAG over your notes, powered by Claude. Ask questions, get summaries, and find connections across your notes.
author: Readied

name: Word Count
description: Shows word, character, and line count in the editor status bar. Essential for writers tracking their progress.
author: Readied

name: Typewriter Mode
description: Keeps the cursor line centered in the editor for a focused, distraction-free writing experience.
author: Readied

name: Active Line Highlight
description: Highlights the line where the cursor is positioned. Makes it easy to track your place in long documents.
author: Readied

name: Tables
description: Insert markdown tables with a command. Tables render beautifully in preview via GitHub Flavored Markdown.
author: Readied

name: Focus Mode
description: Dims all content except the current paragraph. Helps you concentrate on what you're writing right now.
author: Readied

name: Reading Time
description: Shows estimated reading time in the editor header. Based on average reading speed of 200 words per minute.
author: Readied

name: Export Markdown
description: Copy your notes as raw Markdown or rendered HTML. Useful for pasting into emails, blogs, and other tools.
author: Readied
